Order 
Apprehending arrest in Crime No. 132/2023 of Balaramapuram Police Station,
Thiruvananthapuram District, registered for offences under Sections 406, 409, 420, 468, 471 &
120B r/w 34 of the IPC, the petitioner herein/first accused has filed this petition seeking anticipatory bail.

2. The prosecution case is that, accused Nos. 1 & 2 who are the Asst. Manager and Contract Appraiser respectively in the bank and the accused in furtherance of their conspiracy to obtain gold loan money without pledging gold, illegally sanctioned 52 gold loans to the 13 bank accounts of the relatives of the first accused from 21.11.2022 to 06.12.2022 and it is done without actually pledging of the gold ornaments.

According to the prosecution, the petitioner has thereby ..3..
cheated the bank and caused the loss of Rs.3,47,00,000/-.

According to the prosecution, the alleged amounts were transferred to 13 accounts of the friends and relatives of the first accused and once it was found, that the first accused repaid an amount of Rs.1,54,00,000/- and Rs.1,79,00,000/- is remaining to be repaid and thereby, caused loss and damage to the bank and hence, committed the alleged offences.
3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor were heard.
4. By order dated 5.9.2023, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that out of the total amount of Rs.2,56,71,000/-, the petitioner had paid Rs.30,00,000/-.
It was then submitted that the remaining payment would be made after raising funds by the sale of her property.
Today when the matter is taken up, both sides submitted that the entire amount has been paid.
This is recorded.
Under such circumstances, I do not find the custodial interrogation of the petitioner necessary.
Accordingly, this application is allowed, and the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Investigating Officer within seven days from today for interrogation.

After interrogation, in the event the ..4..
petitioner is arrested, she shall be released on bail on executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer, on the following conditions:
i.
The petitioner shall report before the Investigating Officer for interrogation as and when directed.
ii. The petitioner shall fully cooperate with the investigation.
iii.The petitioner shall not induce, threaten or intimidate any person from disclosing facts known to her to the Investigating Officer or the court.
